mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_account WHERE id IN (#{firstUser}, #{secondUser}) AND is_deleted = 0 AND account_status = 1 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_message ( sender_id, recipient_id, content, client_request_id ) VALUES ( #{viewer}, #{peer}, #{content}, #{clientRequestId} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_message WHERE id = #{id} AND ( (sender_id = #{viewer} AND recipient_id = #{peer}) OR (sender_id = #{peer} AND recipient_id = #{viewer}) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{viewer} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END AS peer_id, MAX(id) AS last_id, SUM( CASE WHEN recipient_id = #{viewer} AND read_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS unread_count FROM community_message WHERE sender_id = #{viewer} OR recipient_id = #{viewer} GROUP BY peer_id ) t JOIN user_account u ON u.id = t.peer_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1

SELECT t.peer_id, t.unread_count, m.* FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{viewer} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END AS peer_id, MAX(id) AS last_id, SUM( CASE WHEN recipient_id = #{viewer} AND read_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS unread_count FROM community_message WHERE sender_id = #{viewer} OR recipient_id = #{viewer} GROUP BY peer_id ) t JOIN user_account u ON u.id = t.peer_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 JOIN community_message m ON m.id = t.last_id ORDER BY t.last_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.unread_count, m.id, m.sender_id FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread_count, MAX(m.id) AS latest_id FROM community_message m JOIN user_account u ON u.id = m.sender_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 WHERE m.recipient_id = #{viewer} AND m.read_at IS NULL ) t LEFT JOIN community_message m ON m.id = t.latest_id
